decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program is a low-cost extension of the established offer and has stayed visible on the website, so in a growing industry with adequate slack there is no shortfall that would trigger search for other uses of its resources.

The seventy-two-hour program is more demanding on logistics, but it remained on the website through 2024 and supports the firm's fast-response promise, so management keeps it while its results meet aspirations.
The express line for doors and gates has several models and its own page in both years, which signals solid performance against aspirations and strong commitment.

The online ordering and digital services platform fits the firm's direction toward deeper service and advisory support, is featured on its own page, and is cheap to carry once built, so dropping it is unlikely.
The fire and smoke protection door moved from a mention to a page of its own in 2024, suggesting results above aspiration, and it likely took over the role of the discontinued fire-resistant door C.
